candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that zeroes the recipient's reward balance before sending funds.
Instead of zeroing the reward, set it back to the withdrawn amount, leaving a nonzero balance after withdrawal.
Invert the success check so transfers that succeed cause a revert and failed sends 'succeed', changing the final reward state in the failure scenario.
Remove the statement that marks the bonus as claimed, so the bonus can be claimed repeatedly.
Remove the reward credit, so the withdrawn amount becomes zero instead of the bonus amount.
Change the bonus amount credited from 100 to 101.
Remove the call that withdraws the reward, leaving the credited reward unwithdrawn.
Move the call to withdrawReward before the reward is credited, so zero is withdrawn instead of the bonus.
Remove the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient] before the transfer, so repeated calls can withdraw the reward multiple times.
Remove the require(success) check so the function no longer reverts when the external call fails.
Remove the locking of _locked in the modifier, disabling the reentrancy guard.
Remove the require(!_locked) check so reentrant calls to withdrawReward are no longer blocked.
